purpose: Test three literature-backed cross-sectional crypto characteristics with directions fixed from published evidence before this sample is evaluated.

max_return.reference: Ozdamar, Akdeniz & Sensoy (2021), Financial Innovation, Lottery-like preferences and the MAX effect in the cryptocurrency market
max_return.documented_direction: higher prior maximum daily return associated with higher subsequent cryptocurrency return
max_return.adaptation_note: Published work forms weekly portfolios on prior-month MAX across a broad spot universe. Sprint 10 tests daily next-open transfer to a fixed liquid perpetual universe, so this is a mechanism transfer test, not a paper replication.

skewness.reference: Liu & Chen (2024), International Review of Financial Analysis, Skewness risk and the cross-section of cryptocurrency returns
skewness.documented_direction: higher asymmetry/skewness risk associated with lower subsequent returns
skewness.adaptation_note: Sprint 10 uses trailing daily sample skewness on liquid perpetuals rather than the paper's broader construction.

kurtosis.reference: Jia et al. (2021), Finance Research Letters, Higher moments, extreme returns, and cross-section of cryptocurrency returns
kurtosis.documented_direction: higher historical kurtosis associated with higher future cryptocurrency returns
kurtosis.adaptation_note: Published work uses intraday realized higher moments. Sprint 10 uses trailing daily sample excess kurtosis, so this is a coarse transfer test rather than an exact replication.

data.survivorship_warning: Fixed present liquid universe; historical results do not remove survivorship risk.

execution.execution: next UTC daily open after completed signal day

historical_max_return_momentum.score: maximum completed close-to-close daily return over the most recent N returns ending at t
historical_max_return_momentum.direction: long highest two MAX scores and short lowest two

historical_skewness_premium.score: negative unbiased sample skewness of the most recent N completed close-to-close daily returns ending at t
historical_skewness_premium.direction: long highest two scores (lowest skewness) and short lowest two scores (highest skewness)

historical_kurtosis_premium.score: unbiased Fisher sample excess kurtosis of the most recent N completed close-to-close daily returns ending at t
historical_kurtosis_premium.direction: long highest two kurtosis scores and short lowest two

family_falsification_gate.selection_if_family_passes: Among variants in an adjacent 1.5x-cost-positive neighborhood, select the upper median parameter; never select by maximum PnL.

evidence_boundary.positive_result_only_allows: new frozen candidate followed by independent reproduction, D2, non-overlapping D3 and prospective D4
